brief: Something to keep my sewing supplies tidy.

requirements.requirement: Tidy storage for sewing supplies - compartmentalized bins for small notions
requirements.evidence: bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-full-div3 (3 compartments) and bin:0,1,0~hex-bin-full-div2 (2 compartments) provide subdivided storage for buttons, bobbins, pins, thread

requirements.requirement: Open bin for larger fabric/pattern storage
requirements.evidence: bin:1,0,0~hex-bin-full full-depth open tray in cell 1,0,0
accessory:0#0,0#1 hex-acc-rod for vertical spool rod, accessory:0#1,0#0 hex-acc-hook for scissors/tape, accessory:0#0,1#0 hex-acc-comb for needles/pins - meshClash clear

finish.summary: Compact 3-cell sewing organizer: 3 bins (3-compartment, 2-compartment, open) covering small notions to larger fabric, plus rod socket for spool mast, hook plate for hanging tools, and cable comb for needle organization. Build verified meshClash clear.

lines.label: M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.

events.text:
Build configured for tidy sewing storage across three hex cells.

**Layout:**
- Cell 0,0,0: Bin Full Depth 3 compartments - for small notions (buttons, pins, bobbins)
- Cell 0,1,0: Bin Full Depth 2 compartments - for thread / fabric offcuts
- Cell 1,0,0: Bin Full Depth (open) - for larger items (fabric, pattern sheets)
- Side accessories: Rod socket (0,0,0 slot 1) to stand a dowel/mast for spool stacking, Hook plate (1,0,0 slot 0) for scissors, tape measure, etc., Cable comb (0,1,0 slot 0) to organize needles, pins, cords

Checks: meshClash clear, only LOOSE_BODY warning (joint bolts optional).
